title.narrative: Improving Food, Nutrition & Livelihoods Security of women and men including PLWHA in Yei County

description.narrative: This is a CTP three year supported project designed to respond to the needs of people in the Diocese of Yei, particularly in Tore and Lasu payams of Yei County Central Equatoria State. The goal for this project is to “Improve Nutrition, Food Security and Livelihoods of women and men, including PLWHA in the Diocese of Yei by the end of 2018”. In order to contribute to this goal, Caritas Yei intends to achieve three objectives: 1) Increase access to adequate and quality food by households participating in the project so that vulnerable women and men achieve improved livelihoods security – in terms of food, income or other assets – sufficient to ensure their well-being; 2) Structures, laws and policies relating to livelihoods of women and men living in poverty in Yei County are strengthened, in order to foster peace and development; 3) Partners capacity strengthened on compliance and thematic project pertaining to the delivery of sustainable livelihoods projects. 4) The partner have strengthened structures, laws and policies relating to livelihoods of women and men living in poverty in Ye County in order to foster peace and development. The program will reach 675 households of beneficiaries directly and 2,025 indirectly.
